# Bank alert formats

The fictional banks of the synthetic world (no real bank is named in this repo). parse_bank_alert reads the SMS layout; check_payment_screenshot reads app receipts.

| Bank | Layout | Reference looks like | Time printed as | Also written |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Bank | app_receipt | `KST\d{12}` | `%d %b %Y, %H:%M` | kestrel, kestrel bank plc |
| Harmattan MFB | app_receipt | `HMF-[A-Z0-9]{10}` | `%b %d, %Y %I:%M:%S %p` | harmattan, harmattan microfinance bank, harmattan mfb |
| Lagoonpay | app_receipt | `999\d{27}` | `%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S` | lagoon pay, lagoonpay |
| Ironleaf Bank | sms_alert | `IL/TRF/\d{9}` | `%d/%m/%Y %H:%M` | ironleaf, ironleafbnk, ironleaf bank |
| Ashgrove Bank | sms_alert | `AG/TRF/\d{9}` | `%d/%m/%Y %H:%M` | ashgrove, ashgrovebnk, ashgrove bank |
| Marlwood Bank | sms_alert | `MW/TRF/\d{9}` | `%d %b %Y %H:%M` | marlwood, marlwoodbnk, marlwood bank |

An SMS alert reads, line by line (example, synthetic):

```
Ironleaf Bank Debit Alert
Acct: 01******4821
Amt: NGN84,500.00 DR
Desc: TRF TO CORAL LANE TRADING/IL/TRF/204918377
Time: 27/10/2026 14:02
Avl Bal: NGN12,300.00
```

A debit alert on the shop's phone is a claim. Only the distributor's bank feed (check_payment) makes a payment verified.
